description_en: Retrieves the conversation data of a specified thread and returns the messages generated in each turn in chronological order with pagination
description_zh: 获取指定会话的对话数据，按对话发生的先后顺序分页返回每一轮产生的消息
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-thread-data --name order-analysis-agent --thread-id thread-tiirv9-irwdoal8t4rm --next-token 'e81493d42a7d212810e0ac****' --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetThreadData

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. This parameter is passed in the request path and specifies the DataAgent to which the session belongs
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定会话所属的 DataAgent
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the session to query. This parameter is passed in the request path and is returned by CreateThread
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的会话 ID，通过请求路径传入，由 CreateThread 返回
parameters.name: thread_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Pass the nextToken returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. You do not need to pass this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 翻页游标。传入上一次响应返回的 nextToken 可获取下一页；首次查询无需传入
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of conversation turns to return per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的对话轮数，最大为 100
parameters.name: max_results

schema.description_en: The response body. Returns the conversation data and pagination information of the thread
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回该会话的对话数据与分页信息

data.description_en: The thread data returned in the current request. The data is paginated and sorted in chronological order of the conversation turns
data.description_zh: 本次返回的会话数据，按对话发生的先后顺序分页返回

items.description_en: The data of a single conversation turn

messages.description_en: The list of messages generated in the current conversation turn, including user inputs, agent responses, tool invokes, and status events
messages.description_zh: 本轮对话产生的消息列表，包含用户输入、Agent 回复、工具调用与状态事件

agents.description_en: The list of sub-agent calls initiated in the current message. This field is available only when role is assistant
agents.description_zh: 本条消息中发起的子 Agent 调用列表，仅 role 为 assistant 时可能出现

additionalProperties.description_en: The details of sub-agent invocations. Common fields include name (the name of the sub-agent), arguments (the input parameters for the invocation), and status (the execution status: start, progress, success, or fail)
additionalProperties.description_zh: 子 Agent 调用明细，常见字段为 name（子 Agent 名称）、arguments（本次调用的入参）、status（执行状态：start、progress、success、fail）

items.description_en: The information about a sub-agent call
items.description_zh: 一次子 Agent 调用的信息

artifacts.description_en: The list of artifacts (files) generated by the current message. This field is available only when role is assistant
artifacts.description_zh: 本条消息产出的产物（文件）列表，仅 role 为 assistant 时可能出现

additionalProperties.description_en: The details of artifacts. Common fields include name (the artifact name) and path (the artifact path). You can call operations such as ListArtifacts and GetArtifact to retrieve the generated files
additionalProperties.description_zh: 产物明细，常见字段为 name（产物名称）、path（产物路径）等。可通过 ListArtifacts、GetArtifact 等接口获取已产出的文件

callId.description_en: The call ID of the current execution. Messages that use this value as their parentCallId are its child messages. You can use this field to reconstruct the execution hierarchy of the agent
callId.description_zh: 本次执行的调用标识。以该值为 parentCallId 的消息即为它的下级消息，可用于还原 Agent 的执行层级

contents.description_en: The list of content blocks in the current message

additionalProperties.description_en: The details of content. Common fields include type and value. When type is text, value is the reply text snippet. When type is spin_text, value is the prompt for the thinking and execution process of the agent. When type is thread_title_updated, value is the updated session title. When type is error, value is the fault message that contains code and message. During streaming output, the append (indicates whether it is an incremental snippet) and lastChunk (indicates whether it is the last chunk) markers are also included
additionalProperties.description_zh: 内容明细。常见字段为 type 与 value：type 为 text 时 value 是回复文本片段；type 为 spin_text 时 value 是 Agent 的思考与执行过程提示；type 为 thread_title_updated 时 value 是更新后的会话标题；type 为 error 时 value 是包含 code 与 message 的错误信息。流式输出时还带有 append（是否为增量片段）与 lastChunk（是否为最后一段）标记

detail.description_en: The supplementary description of the current message, such as the description of the action currently being executed
detail.description_zh: 本条消息的补充说明，例如当前正在执行的动作描述

events.description_en: The list of events carried by the current message, which indicates changes in the session status. Common types include: thinking (the agent is thinking), interactive (additional input or confirmation is required), task_finished (the current node is completed, and the payload contains success status and statistics information), stream_done (the current streaming output is completed), error (an execute error occurred), and thread_title_updated (the session title is updated)
events.description_zh: 本条消息携带的事件列表，用于表达会话状态的变化。常见 type：thinking（思考中）、interactive（需要您补充输入或确认）、task_finished（本次任务结束，payload 中带有 success 与统计信息）、stream_done（本次流式输出结束）、error（执行出错）、thread_title_updated（会话标题更新）

additionalProperties.description_en: The details of events. Common fields include type (the event type) and payload (the event data, whose structure varies depending on the event type)
additionalProperties.description_zh: 事件明细，常见字段为 type（事件类型）与 payload（事件数据，结构随事件类型不同而不同）

parentCallId.description_en: The ID of the parent call, which is used to reconstruct the execution hierarchy. An empty string indicates the root node of the current thread
parentCallId.description_zh: 父调用的标识，用于还原执行层级。取值为空字符串时表示本次会话的根节点

role.description_en: The sender of the message. Valid values: assistant (the response or action of the agent), tool (the result of a tool execution), user (the user input), and system (a system message)
role.description_zh: 消息的产生方。取值：assistant（Agent 的回复或动作）、tool（工具执行结果）、user（用户输入）、system（系统消息）

seq.description_en: The sequence number of the message. This number increments within the same thread and can be used to sort messages at the same level. We recommend that you also refer to timestamp instead of relying solely on this value
seq.description_zh: 消息序号，在同一次会话中递增，可用于同级消息排序。建议同时参考 timestamp，不要强依赖该值

timestamp.description_en: The time when the message was generated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in string format
timestamp.description_zh: 消息生成时间，Unix 时间戳，字符串形式

tools.description_en: The list of tool invokes initiated by the agent in the current message. This field is available only when role is assistant
tools.description_zh: 本条消息中 Agent 发起的工具调用列表，仅 role 为 assistant 时可能出现

additionalProperties.description_en: The details of tool invocations. Common fields include name (the tool name), arguments (the input parameters), status (the execution stage status: start, success, or fail), state (the execution result: success or fail), and contents (the tool output content)
additionalProperties.description_zh: 工具调用明细，常见字段为 name（工具名称）、arguments（入参）、status（执行阶段状态：start、success、fail）、state（执行结果：success、fail）、contents（工具输出内容）

type.description_en: The message type. Regular response messages may not have this field. This field appears when the entire message is used to express a status. For example, done indicates that the thread is closed, and error indicates an error message
type.description_zh: 消息类型。常规回复消息可以没有该字段；当整条消息用于表达状态时会出现，例如 done 表示会话结束、error 表示错误消息

version.description_en: The version number of the message structure. Current value: v0.1.0
version.description_zh: 消息结构版本号，当前为 v0.1.0

requestId.description_en: The request ID that generated the current conversation turn. You can use this ID to associate the turn with the CreateChat call that initiated it
requestId.description_zh: 产生本轮对话的请求 ID，可用于关联发起该轮对话的 CreateChat 调用

traceId.description_en: The Tracing Analysis ID of the current conversation turn, which is used to locate the invoke during troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 本轮对话的链路追踪 ID，用于在问题排查时定位本次调用

maxResults.description_en: The actual number of items returned per page in the current request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求实际生效的单页条数

nextToken.description_en: The cursor for the next page. If this field is not returned, it indicates that the last page is reached. Pass this value as nextToken in the request to retrieve the next page
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页的游标。未返回时表示已到最后一页；翻页时将其作为请求中的 nextToken 传入

requestId.description_en: The ID of the current request, which is used to locate the call during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于问题排查时定位本次调用

threadId.description_en: The ID of the session to query, which is the same as the threadId passed in the request path
threadId.description_zh: 本次查询的会话 ID，与请求路径中传入的 threadId 一致

v1_parameters.help_en: The maximum number of conversation turns to return per page. Maximum value: 100
v1_parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的对话轮数，最大为 100
v1_parameters.name: maxResults

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. This parameter is passed in the request path and specifies the DataAgent to which the session belongs
v1_parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定会话所属的 DataAgent
v1_parameters.name: name

v1_parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Pass the nextToken returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. You do not need to pass this parameter for the first query
v1_parameters.help_zh: 翻页游标。传入上一次响应返回的 nextToken 可获取下一页；首次查询无需传入
v1_parameters.name: nextToken

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the session to query. This parameter is passed in the request path and is returned by CreateThread
v1_parameters.help_zh: 要查询的会话 ID，通过请求路径传入，由 CreateThread 返回
v1_parameters.name: threadId
